This lecture uses experimental clinopyroxene (CPX) chemistry to study **linear regression** and temperature prediction. The existing exercises retain their original case studies and will be updated separately.

## Today’s objectives {.unnumbered}

- Fit and interpret simple and multiple linear regression, least squares, coefficients, p-values and $R^2$.
- Examine residual diagnostics, polynomial terms and interactions.
- Understand overfitting, training/test separation, model-search complexity, AIC and grouped cross-validation.
- Interpret prediction errors, confidence intervals for a conditional mean and prediction intervals for an individual observation.
- Distinguish association from causation and discuss scientific limitations.
